walkthroughs.body_html: Christianity has three main branches. Catholics (largest) are led by the Pope in Rome. Orthodox Christians follow ancient Eastern traditions and patriarchs. Protestants split from Catholicism in the 1500s and include Anglicans, Methodists, Baptists and many more.

A church typically has an altar (for communion), pews or chairs (for worshippers), a cross, a pulpit (for sermons), a font (for baptism), and often stained glass windows. Different denominations decorate their churches differently.

Most Christians celebrate special rituals called sacraments, especially baptism (welcoming someone into the faith with water) and Holy Communion / Eucharist (sharing bread and wine in memory of Jesus's Last Supper).

mcqs.q: What distinction matters for the free will defence to the problem of evil?
options: Natural evil means evil that is good for nature.
Act utilitarianism is about action movies and rule utilitarianism is about laws.

Between moral evil (caused by free human choices) and natural evil (earthquakes, disease) — the free will defence directly addresses moral evil but struggles with natural evil, which isn't a product of free choice.
The free will defence solves all forms of evil at once.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between act and rule utilitarianism?
options: Act utilitarianism judges each individual action by its consequences; rule utilitarianism follows rules that, if generally adopted, would produce the most good — sacrificing case-by-case calculation for predictability and fairness.
Act and rule utilitarianism are basically the same approach.
Act utilitarianism is about action movies and rule utilitarianism is about laws.
Natural evil means evil that is good for nature.

mcqs.q: What is the focus of virtue ethics?
options: Virtue ethics is about following the Ten Commandments.
Natural evil means evil that is good for nature.
On character and habits — becoming the kind of person who acts well, aiming at eudaimonia (flourishing) through practising virtues that lie between extremes.
Virtue ethics tells you which specific actions are right and wrong.
